pixel_size_m_note: pixel_size_m is for the 2017 px PNG (the UE import). The EXR value is under exports.exr.
encoding: value_normalised = (height_m - min_height_m) / (max_height_m - min_height_m); height_m = value * (max - min) + min
same_scale_as_source: min/max equal the source heightmap scale (metres = pixel16/65535*389.0)
orientation: row 0 = map y 0 (north, top). Column 0 = map x 0 (west). No flip needed.

png.vertex_spacing_note: if imported as a 2017-vertex landscape (2016 quads) spanning the full map, spacing is map_width/2016

smoothing.method: lake-masked Gaussian, then bilinear sample at 25 m mesh vertices

produced_by: run_pipeline.py (numpy). NOT a Blender render; see REPORT.md
